name: citymeter-shell
about: Shared code of the CityMETER demos. Navigation (0.1.0): address grammar d/at/e/n with browser history, breadcrumb, tab title. Map (0.2.0): camera presets and the building camera, terrain mode, building x-ray, building join and the CityMETER/OSM building units, vector-tile decoding, planar geometry, the basemap style, the MapLibre 5.6.2 guards and the MapLibre loader. Header (0.3.0): the launch card with one automatic retry, the nav-7 glyphs and help dialog, the dataset picker and the list of demos. Levels (0.4.0): the subdistrict (แขวง/ตำบล) and the local administrative unit (อปท.) in the address and the breadcrumb, for the demos that open them; the locale (ย่าน, 0.4.1). Zones (0.4.2): a zone a dataset defines itself stays a filter that opens a level, its crumb has no production link, and the dataset picker names the place `at` hands over. Same bytes in every repository that carries it, and so are the files under shared; change them everywhere at once (demo-platform-review, phase 1).
